definitions.explanation: The act of transporting something out of a location. Used for goods, equipment, materials, or other items being removed from a building, site, or area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{搬出|はんしゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: We started carrying out the luggage.

examples.japanese: {搬出|はんしゅつ}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{完了|かんりょう}した→完了する：20676_kanryousuru⟧。
examples.english: The removal work was completed in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機材|きざい}→機材：13187_kizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{搬出|はんしゅつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please use the elevator for carrying out equipment.

notes:
{搬出|はんしゅつ} means carrying items out of a location. Combines {搬|はん} (transport) + {出|しゅつ} (out). Used in formal, business, and logistics contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {搬出|はんしゅつ}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: removal/moving-out work
- {搬出|はんしゅつ}⟦{経路|けいろ}→経路：13796_keiro⟧: removal route
- {搬出|はんしゅつ}{口|ぐち}: loading/exit dock
- {搬出|はんしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to carry out, to remove

USAGE:
Common in logistics, event setup/teardown, construction, and moving contexts. Often used on signs and in workplace instructions.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {搬出|はんしゅつ}: carrying out (from a location)
- ⟦{搬入|はんにゅう}→搬入：16523_hannyuu⟧: carrying in (to a location)
- ⟦{搬送|はんそう}→搬送：24543_hansou⟧: transport, conveyance (especially of patients or goods over distance)
